verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Elicit publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200 at support.elicit.com/llms.txt) that indexes its Help Center articles, so an agent can be pointed at it directly, and the help articles themselves are served as .md files. Missing for 10: llms.txt scope beyond the Help Center (no machine-readable API reference; OpenAPI paths 404 and the docs-root .md 404), no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt offering, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://support.elicit.com/llms.txt # Elicit Help Center
